sources.note: Sanitized record of both convex CLI attempts: local anonymous dev (exit 0, schema accepted) and cloud deploy (exit 1, login required).
Raw-http probe of the LOCAL surface in both store states. Pre-launch proof activity; deliberately not used to claim anything about a launched app.

sources.locator: Convex billing dashboard — no account exists on this machine, so there is nothing to read

instruments.measures: count of reachable cloud deployments, and the exit code of each provisioning attempt
instruments.method: run `npx convex dev --once` and `npx convex deploy -y` non-interactively (CI=1) and record exit codes and sanitized output; re-runnable by any holder of this repository

instruments.measures: USD minor units billed against the standing grant cap (10000) during the window
instruments.method: read the deploy receipt: no Convex account exists and no billable resource was created; the ledger therefore closes at zero without a provider invoice to read

reachability.measured: 0 reachable cloud deployments; 2 provisioning attempts (exit 0 local-anonymous, exit 1 cloud requiring login)
reachability.conclusion: The launched thing does not exist to be reached; the blocker is one owner login, not the schema or the app.

cost.measured: 0 USD minor units billed of a 10000 minor-unit monthly cap; no account exists to bill
cost.conclusion: Zero spend is a structural fact of the failed deploy, not a report from a billing API — none is configured.

usage.reason: No deployment exists and no human has used even the local surface. Zero real traffic is absence of observation, not evidence of anything.
usage.wouldRequire: A reachable deployment (owner input #2) plus access logs or analytics attached to it.

errors.reason: No error tracker, log drain, or console-capture instrumentation exists for any running instance; the unit-test suite is BUILD evidence, not runtime observation.
errors.wouldRequire: An error tracker or structured log capture on a deployed instance.

performance.reason: Nothing measured latency anywhere; the serve probe recorded bytes and status codes only.
performance.wouldRequire: Timed probes or telemetry against a deployed instance under real load.

taskOutcome.reason: The primary job (migrate the real notebook; answer over it with bindings) cannot be attempted: zero notes and zero owner-authored cases exist (wave-0 receipts).
taskOutcome.wouldRequire: Owner inputs #1 and #3 — the real export and the semantic acceptance cases — wired into the importer run and the scorecard's semantic column.

friction.reason: No friction instrumentation was attached to this run; the receipts record outcomes, not struggle. (Known but uninstrumented example: the convex CLI required the dependency declared in the app package.json before it would run.)
friction.wouldRequire: A human-study event capture or structured run-transcript friction extraction on the next traversal.

feedback.reason: No human has read the report, used the surface, or responded; the countersignature list has been answered by nobody.
feedback.wouldRequire: The owner reading docs/MEW_MIGRATION_RUN_REPORT.md and answering the countersignature list.

observations.observed: `npx convex deploy -y` exited 1: anonymous local development only, cloud deploy requires `npx convex login`. No Convex account or deploy key exists on this machine.
observations.consequence: No deployment exists; usage, performance, taskOutcome and feedback are unobservable until owner input #2 is provided.

observations.observed: `npx convex dev --once` provisioned an anonymous local backend and accepted the hand-written convex/schema.ts: tables notes/links/tags with five indexes (by_sourceId x3, by_sourceDigest, by_name) created.
observations.consequence: The schema half of the deploy path is already proven against a real Convex backend; the owner login is the only missing step between here and a cloud deployment.

observations.observed: 0 minor units were billed during the window: no account exists, and the only backend created was local and anonymous.
observations.inferenceBasis: Derived from the deploy receipt (no account, no cloud resource) rather than read from a billing API, because no billing source is configured; recorded as inferred for exactly that reason.

successCondition.basis: The contract's success condition is defined over a real export copy and owner-authored cases. Neither exists (wave-0A NOT_RUN, wave-0B KILL), and the dimensions the condition depends on — taskOutcome and usage — were never observable in this window. The fixture-run properties hold (importer manifest closes, scorecard deterministic column 8/8) but the condition itself is about the notebook, and there is no notebook here.

unknownsResolved.unknown: Whether Convex deploy credentials exist for this machine; tested at LAUNCH, with a kill receipt if absent.
unknownsResolved.answer: Absent. The cloud deploy exits 1 requiring login; no account or key exists. Bonus finding: convex 1.42.3 falls back to an anonymous LOCAL backend, which accepted the hand-written schema (five indexes) — so after `npx convex login`, the remaining path is deploy plus the rendered-DOM probe.

unknownsStillOpen: Notebook inventory: N notes, M links, K tags — awaiting owner input #1; not estimated.

The exact shape of a real Ideaflow export file; the importer's expected shape is derived from Ideaflow's public data model (notes, hashtags, links, timestamps) and is falsifiable the moment a real export exists.
Semantic acceptance criteria: zero owner-authored test cases exist (wave-0A NOT_RUN receipt); awaiting owner input #3.
Ideaflow hashtag-plus semantics beyond the public hashtag model — preserved raw, uninterpreted.
newUnknowns: Whether the owner authorizes a cloud deployment at all: authority is H0 with no grant artifact to be inside of, so 'can deploy' and 'may deploy' are both open.

Whether the anonymous local Convex backend is acceptable for developing against the real export, or whether all real data must wait for the authenticated project (a privacy call only the owner can make).

instrumentationDebt.wouldRequire: Owner inputs #1 and #3 wired into the importer run and the semantic scorecard column.
The owner reading the run report and answering the countersignature list.
A reachable deployment with access logs or analytics.
An error tracker or structured log capture on a deployed instance.
Structured friction capture on the next traversal (human-study events or run-transcript extraction).

claimed: All eight dimensions are partitioned exactly once: two observed with sources, instruments, windows and sample counts; six unobserved as first-class reports with reasons and wouldRequire.
Both observed reports are backed by a re-readable source (the sanitized deploy receipt) and the one derived number (zero spend) is marked inferred with its basis.
The success condition is answered not-observable, naming the unobserved dimensions that made it so, with zero supporting observations smuggled in.
notRun: No dimension of the launched application was observed, because no launched application exists.

The serve-probe source is declared but backs no observed dimension: probing one's own local process is proof-stage verification, not post-launch observation, and counting it would dress PROVE up as LEARN.

refused.item: Reporting 'no errors observed' or 'no usage problems' for any unobserved dimension
refused.reason: Zero samples supports no statement. Those dimensions are unobserved — a fact about instrumentation, not about the application — and the schema's partition exists precisely so this cannot be blurred.
